verdict.line: You lose short trades into an up Riposte before level 6, but you win the all-in once Riposte is down and you land Q into W.

brief.thesis: Fiora's W (Riposte, 10/9/8/7/6s cooldown) only reflects basic attacks, not abilities — so every trade you take with an auto-attack into an active Riposte is a trade you're volunteering to lose. Riven's Q (Broken Wings) and W (Ki Burst) never trigger it, which means your entire win condition in this 48.2% matchup is baiting the parry with movement or a single throwaway auto, then comboing in with abilities once it's down. This lines up with OP.GG's own read: dodge the W, don't feed it autos.

theirWindow.when: Riposte is up and you auto-attack
theirWindow.what: She parries the hit, gains bonus Attack Damage, and reflects magic damage — never let a basic attack be the first thing you throw when her W is available. Poke or disengage with E (Valor) instead.

yourWindow.what: This is your all-in window. Close with E, land the full Q (Broken Wings) three-hit for the knockback, then W (Ki Burst) to stun and free-hit with autos — she has no parry to punish the auto-attacks in this window.

start.why: Run by 91.4% of Rivens in this matchup at a 47.9% win rate over 359 games — the sustain from the potion is what lets you survive the level 3-5 window where her Q range and Riposte punish you hardest.

boots.why: The majority pick at 50.9% over 234 games — the ability haste lowers your Q (13s) and W (11-7s) cooldowns, which is what lets you re-threaten the all-in window right after her Riposte goes down.

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks through the extended trades this matchup forces — since you can't win the first 1-2 hits into an up Riposte, Conqueror rewards staying in prolonged exchanges once you've baited it out.

summoners.why: The dominant pick at 98.4% pick rate — Ignite cuts through her Duelist passive sustain and punishes the all-in you're setting up around her Riposte cooldown.

playing.title: Never auto into an up Riposte
playing.detail: Check her W icon before every trade. If it's up, open with Q (Broken Wings) or E (Valor), not an auto-attack — Riposte only reflects basic attacks.

playing.title: Respect her 600-range Q
playing.detail: Lunge outranges your 275-range Q by more than double, and she can dash it a second time within a couple seconds at no mana cost. Don't hover at the edge of minion range.

playing.title: All-in the moment Riposte falls
playing.detail: The instant she uses W, her cooldown is 6-10 seconds depending on rank. Close with E, chain Q's three hits for the knockback, then W to stun and free-hit.

playing.title: Use E to eat her Q, not to chase
playing.detail: Valor blocks incoming damage while you step forward — time it to soak a Lunge, not to close distance on a fleeing Fiora who's stacking Burst of Speed.

playing.title: Don't extend fights once her E is active
playing.detail: Burst of Speed stacks move speed on every landed hit or Lunge — a fight that runs long favors her kiting and re-engage, not your burst.

playing.title: Save R for a clean stun-locked burst
playing.detail: Blade of the Exile's Wind Slash and AD/range boost are wasted if she can walk out — fire it only after your W (Ki Burst) stun has landed.

playing.title: Shove and reset before level 6
playing.detail: Since the 3-5 window is hers, push the wave and back rather than contest freezes — trade the minions for tempo, not health.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and win-rate figures are pulled from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.18.1); the tactical reasoning around Riposte timing and trade windows is my own read of the ability interactions.
